_help: Letters everyone receives. Each needs a unique id (never reuse one). rewards: tokens, gifts {sweets/tea/books/flowers: n}, character (id), skin (id). start/end are optional UTC times. Add "to": ["NT-XXXX-XXXX"] to send a letter only to those Player IDs (shown in Settings). This file is also read live from GitHub (remote_url).

mail.title: A present from Haru!
mail.body: Thanks for spending time at the academy! Here are some Memory Tokens, and you can invite any resident you like to your dorm. Choose carefully!
